fact: The World Bank project paper says the Ké-Non management information system, an open-source CORE-MIS/openIMIS-based platform adopted in 2024, is for the first time fully owned and operated directly by the government, and the financing continues investment in it for the Vulnerable Family Program cash transfers.
The World Bank project paper says the additional financing continues an electronic cash-transfer payment system for beneficiaries, built through a partnership with a financial institution.

openIMIS says the government adopted Ke-Non, built on CORE-MIS and openIMIS, in May 2023 to manage the national social protection system and its conditional cash transfer programme, housed at the Institute of Innovation and Knowledge.
openIMIS says Ke-Non's payment module works with Banco Internacional de Sao Tome e Principe for the conditional cash transfer programme.
